(
Practice
Mirror of the Storybook flow Flows/Karaoke/Practice (src/features/karaoke/karaoke-practice-surface and karaoke-route-view), phone only, with design changes listed below.
Full screen: the shared activity header (a close mark and a progress bar that follows the song), a blurred artwork backdrop, and a centred lyric stage with the current line large and the next line smaller and muted. The one footer button says Start and nothing else. The first time a person records, a short notice says where the recording goes before the microphone is asked for. While the microphone and scoring session connect, the same Start button shows a spinner and is disabled. If the browser blocks the microphone or none is found, a notice sits above the footer and Start stays available to try again. While singing there is no footer; each sung word fills with the warning colour and a rating (a word and its points) appears just above the lyrics as an overlay that never moves them. If the music stops mid-take, the footer says Playback stopped with one button, Resume. If the music cannot start, it says it couldn't play with one button, Try again.
The close mark leaves at once before Start. While singing it asks "Stop singing?" first, with Keep singing and Stop, because leaving ends the take unscored (last group).
The group before the last is the end of a take, drawn as the pages in order: Result, Streak, Rewards, and the Result variant when the song has a reward and no lottery entry was earned. They are clones of the shared page on the Parts page, where the sequence and its rules are written. The code's Karaoke results carry no streak today; the streak page needs the take's qualification to report a streak day, as Study's does.
Design changes from the code, all unapproved: the header's exit is a close mark where the code draws a caret that goes back, and it asks before stopping a take; the button reads Start in every state (the code says Start karaoke, then Start singing while busy); the rating sits closer to the lyrics; the music messages and buttons are shorter and have no "backing track", "press play" or "tap to continue"; the recording notice is one sentence and says "both of us" where the code names Pirate and a 24 month retention, since a person on a community's own domain has no notion of Pirate. Spec 019 section 5.1 requires a first-use disclosure derived from the provider terms, so its final wording needs that review.
The production route supplies no reward badge, so none is drawn. The artwork is a placeholder gradient.
Not drawn: the no-scorable-lines state (lyrics only, no action), the empty stage, other capture errors ("Audio capture could not start", "Scoring could not connect"), and desktop.
